notes.title: Mini Update: Map Search Fix Attempt
notes.content:
Hey everyone, just pushed a small update to (hopefully) fix an issue where some maps weren’t showing up in the search results.

What changed:

Tweaked how maps get indexed so they should appear more reliably in search.

Since it’s just me working on this, I can’t test every possible case — so if you still run into missing maps, please drop a note in the community hub and I’ll dig in.

Thanks again for all your patience and support. Your maps and feedback really keep this project going!

notes.title: 🎉 New Big Update Now in the BETA Branch! 🛠️
notes.content:
Hey stealth artists,
I just pushed a major new update to the Beta version of Exit Strategy, and I’d love your help testing it out before it goes live to everyone!
🔍 What’s New in This Update:
This update brings a ton of improvements, including:

🧑‍💼 Brand-new character models with a quirky stop motion animation style, inspired by Wallace & Gromit!

🧠 Improved AI behaviors – coworkers now roam, chat, sit, and interact with their surroundings more naturally.

🌆 New map environments – including Medium and Large office layouts to expand your creativity.

🔨 Level editor upgrades – more placeable items and quality-of-life tools to streamline map creation.

🌀 Performance boost – I saw up to 40% FPS improvement during internal testing!

☕ New Chaos Meter – finally, a way to quantify your glorious workplace disruption.
🐞 Known Editor Bugs:
Heads up – there are a few lingering bugs in the level editor (mostly UI quirks and object placement). I’m already working on fixes, and they’ll be patched soon. Thanks for being patient while I smooth things out!
[hr][/hr]🧪 How to Access the BETA Version:
Want to try the update early? Here’s how:
[olist]
Open your Steam Library.

Right-click on Exit Strategy and select Properties.

Click the BETAS tab.

Select beta - Public Beta Test from the dropdown.

Let it update, then launch the game!
[/olist]
📺 Prefer a video guide? Here’s a quick tutorial on switching to Steam beta branches:
👉 
[previewyoutube="I2SxlgBWD9I;full"][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]🧵 What Do You Think?
I’d love to hear your thoughts on the new stop motion animation look and the Wallace & Gromit–style character designs. Are they charming? Weird? Hilarious? Let me know what you think in the comments!
[hr][/hr]
Thanks so much for all your support and feedback. Can’t wait to see the chaos you unleash with the new tools.

—Kevin (Solo Dev of Exit Strategy)
💼🕵️‍♂️

notes.title: 🛠️ Early Access Update: Boss Behavior, Food Fights, and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

A fresh build just went live, and it brings a bunch of new mayhem to your workplace escape plan:

🔹 The Boss is Meaner
He’s more aggressive now—and worse, he has your cell number. Expect calls. You can Answer, Decline, or Turn Off the Ringer… but be careful, a ringing phone can give away your location!

📱 New Mechanic: Cell Phone Interruptions
Just when you think you’ve got a clean getaway, your boss might call. Play it smart or get caught mid-sneak.

🍽️ Fridge Drama Intensifies

Power Bowl and Lasagna are now in the fridge

If you eat them… someone will notice.

New co-worker reactions added—enjoy the guilt trip.

🎵 New Title Music
Now the menu screen slaps. That is all.

🤖 AI Improvements

Patched two sneaky logic holes in AI behavior

Added ability to knock down co-workers, or even push/hit them with items (you absolute menace)

🧠 Next Up
We’re working on:

Room lighting switches and reactions to them

More random coworker behavior

Medium and large office layouts for varied gameplay

Got a fun idea or evil plan for a distraction mechanic?
👉 Drop your requests here or chat with us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/djP6N5E5MM

Thanks again for all your support and feedback!

– Kevin
Solo dev behind Exit Strategy
